title: Jean-Talon Market & Little Italy Private Tour
includes: Explore the true Montreal's institution at your own pace.
To make communication easier, you will receive name and number of your guide.
Forget the stale and boring conventional tours, our guides are fun, dynamic and upbeat.
Gratuities are not mandatory, however very much appreciated (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: This tour may involve sampling of various snacks and foods. Please advise your guide if you have any dietary restrictions/requirements or allergies.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Montreal’s Jean-Talon Market on this private walking tour. Follow your local guide through the maze of stalls as you discover local delicacies, some of which you wouldn’t find on your own. Explore the fascinating neighbourhood of Little Italy, and receive the personal attention of your guide. Plus, get restaurant, wine, and beer recommendations from your in-the-know guide.
